0.$description: Elevation step 0 - flush with the page, no shadow (inline content, flat surfaces).

1.$description: Elevation step 1 - subtle lift for resting cards and panels.

2.$description: Elevation step 2 - hovered cards and the site header when the page scrolls beneath it.

3.$description: Elevation step 3 - floating surfaces anchored to a trigger: dropdowns, popovers, tooltips.

4.$description: Elevation step 4 - transient overlays not anchored to a trigger: toasts, notifications.

5.$description: Elevation step 5 - highest layer, sits above a scrim: modals and dialogs.

card.$description: Default resting elevation for cards and content panels.

card-hover.$description: Elevation for a card or panel on hover/focus-within.

header.$description: Sticky/fixed header once the page has scrolled beneath it.

dropdown.$description: Dropdown menus, select listboxes, and comboboxes.

tooltip.$description: Tooltips and popovers anchored to their trigger.

modal.$description: Modal and dialog surfaces presented above the scrim.

color.$description: Backdrop/scrim color behind modals and off-canvas panels, derived from {color.neutral.gray-900}.
